report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with low latency (62-78ms) except one 344ms outlier; logs show no errors, metrics show zero 502s, and traces show healthy downstream calls. No fault is established by current evidence, so no bounded root cause can be asserted. Handing off rather than fabricating a cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error-rate data over a longer window to confirm whether the 344ms outlier is anomalous
